title: Research Data Management — Spreadsheets, Coding, Cleaning and Backup

hook.en: The most common way to lose a research project is not a failed experiment. It is a spreadsheet with colours as data, a file named "final_final2", and one laptop that stops working. Good data habits are boring, and they save months.
hook.ur: Research project khone ka sab se aam tareeqa nakam tajruba nahi. Yeh woh spreadsheet hai jis mein rang data hain, "final_final2" naam ki file, aur ek laptop jo kaam karna band kar de. Achhi data ki aadatein bore karne wali hain, aur mahine bachati hain.

goal.en: By the end, you'll set up a tidy data spreadsheet, write a simple data dictionary, clean and check data safely, follow the 3-2-1 backup rule, and protect participants' privacy.
goal.ur: End tak aap saaf data spreadsheet banayenge, saada data dictionary likhenge, data ko mehfooz tareeqe se saaf aur check karenge, 3-2-1 backup ka qaida follow karenge, aur shirkat karne walon ki nijiyat mehfooz rakhenge.

text.en: Use **tidy data**: one row per participant (or per measurement), one column per variable, one value per cell. Avoid merged cells, colours or comments as data, and mixed text and numbers in one column. Give each participant a **code** (for example P001) and keep the key linking codes to names in a **separate, protected file**. Write a **data dictionary** explaining each column name, units, allowed values and what missing means. Keep a **raw data** file untouched and do all cleaning in a copy or by script. Back up with **3-2-1**: three copies, two different media, one off-site.
text.ur: **Tidy data** istemal karein: ek row per shirkat karne wala (ya per paimaish), ek column per variable, ek cell mein ek value. Merged cells, rang ya comments ko data ke taur par aur ek column mein mila-jula text aur numbers se bachein. Har shirkat karne wale ko ek **code** (masalan P001) dein aur codes ko naam se jorne wali chabi **alag, mehfooz file** mein rakhein. Har column ka naam, units, jaiz values aur missing ka matlab batane wala **data dictionary** likhein. **Raw data** file ko chhune na dein aur saari safai copy ya script mein karein. **3-2-1** se backup karein: teen copies, do mukhtalif media, ek bahar ki jagah.

text.en: Think of **a well-organised pharmacy shelf**. Every medicine has a label, a place and an expiry date, and the register records what was taken. When someone asks "do we have it?", the answer takes seconds. A tidy spreadsheet is the same: every value has a place, a label and a note. Months later, you or a stranger can find what you need.
text.ur: **Munazzam dawakhane ki shelf** sochein. Har dawai ka label, jagah aur expiry hoti hai, aur register mein likha hota hai kya liya gaya. Jab koi poochhe "kya hamare paas hai?" to jawab seconds mein milta hai. Tidy spreadsheet aisi hi hai: har value ki jagah, label aur note hai. Mahinon baad aap ya koi ajnabi dhoondh sakta hai jo chahiye.

question.en: A student marks excluded participants by colouring the rows red. What is the better way?
question.ur: Ek talib-e-ilm khaarij shirkat karne walon ko rows laal rang kar ke dikhati hai. Behtar tareeqa kya hai?

text.en: Add a column such as "excluded" with 0 or 1 and a second column giving the reason
text.ur: "excluded" jaisa column 0 ya 1 ke saath jorein aur doosra column wajah ke saath

feedback.en: Yes — a column can be filtered, counted and kept when copied.
feedback.ur: Haan — column chhanta, ginta aur copy par mehfooz rakha ja sakta hai.

question.en: Which backup practice follows the 3-2-1 rule?
question.ur: Kaun sa backup amal 3-2-1 qaide par hai?

text.en: Three copies, on two kinds of storage, with one kept off-site (for example, a laptop, an external drive and an encrypted cloud copy)
text.ur: Teen copies, do qism ke storage par, ek bahar ki jagah (masalan laptop, external drive aur encrypted cloud copy)

feedback.en: Yes — it protects against theft, fire and hardware failure.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh chori, aag aur hardware kharabi se bachata hai.

text.en: Two copies on the same laptop
text.ur: Ek hi laptop par do copies

feedback.en: A single copy is a risk.

text.en: So that you and others can understand each column, its units and codes, even months later
text.ur: Taake aap aur doosre har column, uske units aur codes samajh saken, mahinon baad bhi

feedback.en: Yes — it makes data reusable and checkable.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh data ko dobara istemal aur jaanchne ke qabil banata hai.

text.en: It is required only for large studies
text.ur: Sirf bade studies ke liye zaroori

feedback.ur: Chhote projects ko bhi faida hota hai.

text.ur: Spreadsheet ko lamba karne ke liye

text.en: **Cleaning the data until it looks right.** Removing "weird" values without a rule is a form of p-hacking. Check suspicious values against the original form or ask the clinician, fix obvious entry errors, and record every change. Never overwrite the raw data. Also, remember Excel can change gene-like names or ranges into dates: set column types and check imported data.
text.ur: **Data ko tab tak saaf karna jab tak theek na lage.** Bina qaide ke "ajeeb" values hatana p-hacking ki ek shakl hai. Shak wali values ko asal form se milayein ya clinician se poochhein, saaf data-entry ki ghaltiyan theek karein, aur har tabdeeli likhein. Raw data par kabhi na likhein. Yeh bhi yaad rakhein ke Excel naamon ya ranges ko tareekhon mein badal sakta hai: column ki qism tay karein aur import shuda data jaanchein.

text.en: **Enter data once, check twice.** Design a simple paper or tablet form with the same order as the spreadsheet. Enter data soon after collection, and have a second person check a random 10 percent against the originals. Use drop-down lists or validation rules to limit typing errors, such as ranges for age or pain scores.
text.ur: **Data ek baar dalein, do baar jaanchein.** Saada kaghazi ya tablet form spreadsheet ki tarteeb mein banayein. Jama karne ke baad jaldi data dalein, aur doosra shakhs asal se 10 fisad random jaanche. Typing ghaltiyan kam karne ke liye drop-down lists ya validation rules istemal karein, jaise umar ya dard ke scores ki ranges.

answer.en: FAIR stands for Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable. It means data should have clear identifiers and descriptions, be available (with appropriate permission), use common formats and be documented well enough for others to reuse. For a small clinic project, it simply means: name files clearly, document columns, use standard formats such as CSV and store in a place others can access when ethically appropriate.
answer.ur: FAIR ka matlab Findable, Accessible, Interoperable aur Reusable hai. Iska matlab hai data ka saaf shanakhti nishan aur tafseel ho, (munasib ijazat ke saath) dastiyab ho, aam formats istemal kare aur itna achha document ho ke doosre dobara istemal kar saken. Chhote clinic project ke liye yeh sirf yeh hai: files ke saaf naam rakhein, columns document karein, CSV jaise mayaari formats istemal karein aur akhlaqi taur par munasib ho to aisi jagah rakhein jahan doosre pohanch saken.

beats.patient: A student collects pain and function scores from 80 patients in four clinics. Each clinic uses its own spreadsheet layout and colours, and one laptop is stolen with the only copy.
beats.assessment: The data are inconsistent, undocumented and unprotected.
beats.treatment: A better plan: a single template with participant codes, a data dictionary, shared protected storage with regular backups, and a second person checking 10 percent of entries.
beats.reassess: The next student rebuilds the dataset in two weeks and finishes the analysis on time.

text.en: **Protect privacy and patients.** Keep identifiers separate, encrypt laptops and cloud storage, use strong passwords and never email identifiable data. Delete data when you promised to. If you find a serious problem in the data, such as a participant at risk, follow your safety plan rather than just recording it.
text.ur: **Nijiyat aur mareezon ki hifazat karein.** Pehchanein alag rakhein, laptops aur cloud storage encrypt karein, mazboot passwords istemal karein aur pehchan wala data kabhi email na karein. Jab waada kiya data mita dein. Agar data mein seriyas masla dikhe, jaise koi shirkat karne wala khatre mein, to sirf record karne ke bajaye apne safety plan par amal karein.

text.en: Broman and Woo gave practical advice on organising data in spreadsheets, such as being consistent, writing dates in a standard format, putting one thing in each cell, creating a data dictionary, not using font colour or highlighting as data, and saving data in plain text files, because small habits make analysis easier and reduce errors. The FAIR principles propose that research data should be findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable, to improve the value of data for both people and machines.
text.ur: Broman aur Woo ne spreadsheets mein data ko tarteeb dene ki amali rehnumai di, jaise mustaqil rehna, tareekhein mayaari format mein likhna, har cell mein ek cheez rakhna, data dictionary banana, font ka rang ya highlighting ko data ke taur par istemal na karna, aur data plain text files mein mehfooz karna, kyunke chhoti aadatein tajziya aasaan banati hain aur ghaltiyan kam karti hain. FAIR usool tajweez karte hain ke research data findable, accessible, interoperable aur reusable hona chahiye, taake logon aur machines dono ke liye data ki qeemat barhe.

text.en: **Tidy, Codes, Dictionary, Raw, 3-2-1.** Tidy table, participant codes, data dictionary, untouched raw file and 3-2-1 backups.
text.ur: **Tidy, Codes, Dictionary, Raw, 3-2-1.** Tidy table, shirkat karne walon ke codes, data dictionary, ghair-chhua raw file aur 3-2-1 backups.

summary.en: Keep data tidy: one row per participant, one column per variable, one value per cell, with participant codes and a data dictionary.
summary.ur: Data tidy rakhein: ek row per shirkat karne wala, ek column per variable, ek cell mein ek value, codes aur data dictionary ke saath.

summary.en: Keep raw data untouched, record every cleaning step and back up with the 3-2-1 rule.
summary.ur: Raw data ko ghair-chhua rakhein, har safai ka qadam likhein aur 3-2-1 qaide se backup karein.

summary.en: Protect privacy with separate keys, encryption and secure storage.
summary.ur: Alag chabiyon, encryption aur mehfooz storage se nijiyat mehfooz rakhein.

back.ur: Aisi dastavez jo har column, uske units aur jaiz values samjhaye.

back.ur: Teen copies, do qism ke media, ek bahar ki jagah.
